messages.subject: Status of R packages
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

after release of Debian 10 I tried to catch up to update all R packages
to recent upstream versions (since in freeze policy was forbidding this
and we were lagging behind).

Currently 7 packages are waiting for new preconditions in new queue.  I
documented in d/changelog in Git on what package these are waiting for.

However, there is also one packages I found an issue in the test suite I
have no idea how to cope with:

r-cran-fpc (2.2-3-1) UNRELEASED; urgency=medium

autopkgtest is failing:
    k=  3  flexmix error in run  1
     Error in flexout[[optimalk]] :
       attempt to select less than one element in get1index <real>
    Calls: flexmixedruns -> summary
    Execution halted
    autopkgtest [06:15:54]: test run-unit-test: -----------------------]
    autopkgtest [06:15:54]: test run-unit-test:  - - - - - - - - - - results - - - - - - - - - -
    run-unit-test        FAIL non-zero exit status 1

It would be really great if some volunteer would deal with this.
There is another issue

r-cran-rhandsontable (0.3.7+dfsg-1) UNRELEASED; urgency=medium

  TODO: replace inst/htmlwidgets/lib/numbro/languages.min.js by
    https://github.com/BenjaminVanRyseghem/numbro

which seems to be complex since it requires extra JS packages.  I'd be
really happy if someone joins in here.  I admit that I'm doing currently
a lot to keep R packages up to date - a bit more than expected since I
expected when we started this team.  So please keep on watching

   https://salsa.debian.org/r-pkg-team/maintenance-utilities/blob/master/outdated_r-packages.txt

the upcoming three weeks.  It would be nice if there would not be lots
of updating work left for me in November.

Kind regards

       Andreas.

--
